name: Kuzuryuu Kiriya
source:
Hobbies: Going to doujin and live seiyuu events
Likes: All kinds of games, [url=http://danielfooddiary.com/2016/09/26/machidashoten/]iekei ramen[/url]
Dislikes: Talking to people with no otaku hobbies, carbonated drinks

[url=/c55449]Shinobu's[/url] classmate and best friend, the two have been close ever since they found out they're both otaku. Kiriya is a member of the 2D club and very talented at making things with computers - he can edit pictures, write scripts, programming, music, and so on. He is even part of a video game developer group. Though he doesn't have any experience himself, Kiriya loves giving advice to Shinobu and always butts into conversations regarding love. However, he does have a crush on [url=/c53407]Ren[/url] even though the two fight often over their favorite characters and genres.
